sources.title: Meinolf Geck, Modular Representations of Hecke Algebras

contents.name: Generic versus specialized finite-Coxeter Hecke algebras
contents.reason: The source is used as an independent parameter/specialization treatment. Its multiplicative parameter is not silently identified with the local v convention; the rescaling S=vT and xi=v^2 is stated in the A-page parameter map, while the example's calculation follows the local definition.

contents.name: Semisimplicity classification for all Coxeter Hecke specializations
